description: Found it among the ink-things, black to the neck, and set it on the board beside the pot.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Counted one short, accused nobody, and said the spoon had been put there to be found.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Sat at the end of the bench, nodded at the loaf, and did not speak.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Sat three rows ahead in the carved pew and did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Turned the sand-glass twice and sent the parish to dinner with the number ten.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Looked at the spoon on the board and left it there.
name: William Shakespeare
